summary.oneLiner: Chatterbox (brand "Chtrbox") is India's first publicly-listed influencer-marketing / creator-economy platform, an ~decade-old QYOU Media subsidiary run by ex-TikTok exec Raj Mishra. FY26 (maiden year as a listed co) delivered revenue +42.5% to ₹84.2cr, but it was a "year of strategic investment" — **margins compressed** (EBITDA 20.6%→17%, PAT 15.0%→10.9%) as it spent on talent, platform/tech and new verticals. The market has been unimpressed: **market cap has fallen from ~₹160cr at IPO to ~₹78cr**. Optionality sits in a still-unlaunched AAGE edutainment app, MENA/international expansion via the Dubai hub, and un-confirmed talk of a QYOU-into-Chatterbox merger.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- India's only publicly listed influencer marketing company and the first MNC to list on BSE SME, positioned as a full-stack growth partner for brands and creators.
- Integrated creator-economy platform covering the full value chain: creator discovery, campaign strategy/execution, talent management (Chtrbox Represent) and monetisation.
- Track record since 2016: 2,000+ campaigns executed, ~500-influencer network with 104 creators under exclusive management, and 50Mn+ cumulative follower reach across 500+ client brands.
- Domestic revenue 82% / international revenue 18%, with operations spanning India, UAE, Singapore, USA and UK.

segment_detail.title: Segment / subsidiary detail
segment_detail.body:
**Six verticals** (branding):
- **Chtrbox Represent** — exclusive talent management (manage ~100+ creators exclusively; help social-media growth, personal branding, monetization).
- **ChtrSocial** — social-media growth engine + content/video production for brands.
- **BharatBox** — Tier-2/Tier-3 regional creators (localization).
- **Youth:ink** — Gen-Z / campus engagement division.
- **Chtr Studios** — professional video content creation.
- **Chtr International** — overseas expansion vehicle (Dubai subsidiary → Middle East gateway).

**Revenue mix (FY26, as reported by CFO):** Chatterbox Represent **39.27%** · Brand Solutions **36.18%** · ChtrSocial **24.55%**. Geography: domestic **~82%**, international **~18%**. Highest-margin: **ChtrSocial + production arm**; most scalable (fixed-margin but growing absolute $): **Represent**.

Scale metrics: works with **500+ brands**, **2,000+ campaigns** executed, **100+ exclusive creators**, team of **100+**. History: founded 2016; by 2018 ~25+ marquee brands (Ray-Ban, Flipkart, Whisper, Godrej), ~$1m+ revenue; acquired by QYOU Media 2021.

order_book.title: Order book & pipeline
order_book.body: Services / campaign model — no formal order book. Growth "engines" cited: (1) ChtrSocial (fastest-growing vertical, brands consolidating spend); (2) technology/AI in-house platform (efficiency layer, not yet a separate revenue line); (3) exclusive talent management (Represent) — "significant headroom"; (4) international. FY26 topline growth attributed to a mix of (a) deeper wallet-share / larger integrated mandates from existing marquee clients, (b) higher campaign count, (c) international contribution. Did **not** disclose net-revenue-retention (no formal NRR metric) or top-5 customer concentration (declined).

guidance.title: Guidance (CRITICAL — verify next quarter)
guidance.body:
- **No formal financial guidance given** ("we don't really provide specific financial guidance").
- Revenue growth: FY26 grew 42%; mgmt "pretty bullish"/optimistic on **sustaining healthy growth medium-to-long term**; cites global creator economy CAGR **25–30%** and BCG's India creator economy **>$1trn annual spend by 2030**. On ChtrSocial specifically: expect to **"at a bare minimum double down on the revenue"** for that vertical in coming months.
- Margin (FY27, net/PAT): **"expect similar margins to continue"** — i.e. ~10% PAT; **targeting higher**, management "actively working on margin expansion at the bottom line" by streamlining other opex. (Watch: this is a soft de-facto ~10% PAT floor.)
- Revenue mix: ChtrSocial contribution **expected to keep rising** as brands consolidate social + content + influencer spend with integrated partners.
- Product: **AAGE edutainment app** — resume development and **launch within FY27** ("in this FY is what we are aiming for").
- International: currently ~18% of revenue; scale via MENA (immediate priority), then APAC / LATAM / SE-Asia — **disciplined, lean, no simultaneous multi-market burn**.

growth_optionality.title: Growth verticals / optionality
growth_optionality.body:
- **AAGE app** — mobile-first, short-form **edutainment** platform (gamified learning + short-form video + AI) targeting Gen-Z / young millennials; content areas: skill development, career readiness, financial literacy, entrepreneurship. Currently early-stage; ₹4.68cr in intangibles-under-development; was **put on hold** during the IPO, resuming with a targeted **FY27 launch**. Validating model with focus groups before scaling.
- **In-house technology / AI platform** — core investment; efficiency/discovery/analytics layer, potential future standalone commercialization ("would certainly evaluate").
- **International** — Dubai hub live; leveraging QYOU global network; MENA/GCC → APAC/LATAM; help Indian brands into GCC and vice-versa.
- **M&A optionality** — Curt Marvis flags "tremendous M&A activity in the creator economy"; being a **public vehicle** opens accretive M&A not available privately; "things we're looking at."

margins.title: Margins & cost dynamics
margins.body: FY26 margin compression is the central financial story: EBITDA margin **~20.6%→17%**, PAT margin **~15.0%→10.9%**, driven by deliberate spend on talent acquisition, platform/tech capabilities, business-expansion initiatives and new-vertical scaling. Highest-margin activities: ChtrSocial + production. Represent is fixed-margin but scalable in absolute terms. FY27: mgmt guides "similar margins," targeting improvement via opex streamlining and operating leverage.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.body: IPO proceeds strengthened balance sheet — net worth ₹70.06cr. Mgmt language: "disciplined capital allocation," improving working-capital efficiency, better cash conversion, tighter receivable days. Reinvesting into platform/tech, talent and lean international expansion. Open to **accretive M&A** via the public vehicle. No dividend/buyback mentioned. Dubai subsidiary deliberately **not 100%-owned** (reason requested by an analyst but **not answered on the call**).

management_tone.title: Management quality / tone
management_tone.body: Confident, narrative-heavy, promotional register ("mic drop statement," "do it for breakfast," Lionsgate $100m→$5bn 50x story). Maiden call as a listed company. Curt Marvis leaned on his Lionsgate track record and creator-economy M&A thesis; Raj Mishra on TikTok pedigree and platform vision. Notable friction: defensive/curt responses to pointed questions on the market-cap collapse, the QYOU merger, PAT-margin drop, disclosure and the results-communication delay — a governance/tone flag for a newly-listed name. Farrel Arora (CFO) handled the numbers cleanly and disclosed the delay reason.

moat.title: 6a. Moat & competitive position (OPTIONAL)
moat.body:
- **Creator stickiness** — many exclusive creator relationships "continued for several years"; positioned as long-term growth partner (personal branding, content strategy, PR, monetization) vs a transactional campaign intermediary — raises switching costs. (No formal retention metric disclosed; "simple math," mgmt "pleased with stability.")
- **QYOU Media parentage** — access to global relationships, international best practices, tech-sharing, capital-market experience; Dubai clients sourced from existing QYOU/Chatterbox client operations.
- **Founder pedigree** — Raj Mishra ex-TikTok (led India → Middle East / Indonesia / Brazil expansion, Chief Strategy Officer for Asian/GCC); Curt Marvis ex-Lionsgate/MTV, ~3 decades public-markets. Genuine, but narrative-heavy — treat as management-quality signal, not a hard moat.

risks.title: Risks & watch-items
risks.body:
- **Valuation de-rating** — market cap fell from ~₹160cr at IPO to **~₹78cr** at the call; PAT margin nearly halved YoY. Sentiment/execution risk is live.
- **QYOU merger uncertainty** — an analyst asked directly whether QYOU Media (foreign-listed) would merge into Chatterbox (to avoid US listing fees) at the ₹78cr mcap; Curt Marvis **declined to comment** ("not something I would comment on or discuss"). Overhang / related-party governance question.
- **Investor-communication / governance optics** — analysts flagged (a) long gap between results (29-May), IP upload (~last week) and concall (29-Jun); (b) reluctance to disclose top-5 customers, NRR, retention. Mgmt attributed the delay to a **promoter's personal family exigency**; Raj Mishra bristled ("refuse to comment") before promising periodic engagement.
- **Disclosure gaps** — no NRR, no top-customer concentration, no formal retention metric, no revenue/margin guidance → limited visibility.
- **AAGE execution/slippage** — previously shelved; unproven monetization.
- **Dubai sub not wholly-owned** — minority structure unexplained.
- **Small scale + key-man** — ~₹84cr revenue, heavy reliance on Raj Mishra / QYOU relationships.

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious takeaways
non_obvious.body:
- **"First publicly listed influencer-marketing company in India"** — scarcity/first-mover framing is central to the equity story.
- **QYOU-into-Chatterbox merger** floated by an analyst (to sidestep US listing costs) — management would not confirm or deny; a structural catalyst/overhang to watch.
- **Market cap ~halved from IPO** (~₹160cr → ~₹78cr) while revenue grew 42% — the disconnect drove the sharpest Q&A.
- Reporting-segment labels ("Chatterbox Represent / Brand Solutions / ChtrSocial") **differ from the six marketing-verticals** — reconcile carefully when tracking mix QoQ.
- Union Budget FY27 formally recognized the **"orange economy"** (creativity/content/culture) — cited as a policy tailwind.
- AAGE intangibles unchanged at ₹4.68cr because the app was **shelved during the IPO** (not organic stall) — now un-paused.

qoq_log.body:

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Parentage] Chatterbox is a subsidiary of QYOU Media Inc., a TSX Venture Exchange (Canada)-listed media/creator-economy group operating in the US and India, with FY2025 (year ended Dec-31-2025) consolidated revenue of CAD 32.2 Mn (~INR 218 Cr).
- [Leadership] MD & CEO Raj Mishra is former India Country Head for TikTok and Head of Strategy at ByteDance, with earlier roles at Musical.ly and Triller; QYOU Media co-founder/CEO Curt Marvis was previously President of Digital Media at Lionsgate.
- [Industry backdrop] Deck cites India's influencer-marketing market reaching ₹3,375 Cr (~US$405M) by 2026 at an 18% CAGR, versus a global market growing from US$16B (2023) to US$307B (2033) at 34% CAGR.
